sources.title: Snapshot Compression
sources.read_scope: Entire textual article; especially Delta Compression. Embedded video and linked code not inspected.

sources.author: Glenn Fiedler
sources.title: Reliability and Congestion Avoidance over UDP
sources.read_scope: Sequence Numbers, Acks, Reliable Acks, Detecting Lost Packets.
sources.adopted_scope: Packet reception acknowledgements and loss of acknowledgements; no adoption of congestion parameters, TCP summary, sequence-comparison code or reliability guarantees.

own_example: Same valid session, exact integer states100:x10,101:x11,102:x12. If101 is lost,102 relative to101 cannot be decoded using100. Relative to retained100, delta+2 reconstructs12. These are alternative paper encodings, not transmitted packets.
limits: No network, library, engine or service execution; no benchmark or shipped-game result.
Receipt, successful snapshot reconstruction, baseline acceptance and later retention are distinct protocol obligations. The sources do not provide a complete eviction or resynchronization algorithm.
Rolling article URLs are dated publications, not immutable source snapshots.
